primary_endpoint: Predicted mean percent change from baseline in liver biopsy-derived HSD17B13 protein and mRNA expression at weeks 8, 12, and 28.
efficacy_outcome: Protein expression changes ranged from -26.82% to -88.79%; mRNA expression changes ranged from -28.55% to -92.95% across doses and reported timepoints. No comparator or statistical significance values were provided.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events occurred in 1/17 participants at 25 mg, 0/15 at 200 mg, 1/15 at 400 mg, and 0/14 at 800 mg; no deaths were reported.
